title: Session 6 note
aim: Hear the major scale as pairs of thirds, and read a groove from TAB with its rhythm.
meta: Leith Bass Space · Four-string bass in standard tuning

portal.covered: C major in thirds; reading rhythm from TAB
portal.summary: We played C major in thirds in second position and read the Em groove from TAB with the rhythm shown.
objectives: C major in thirds, slowly, saying the note names
Em groove from the TAB, looped with a drum loop
portal.nextTime: Thirds coming back down, and the same groove in notation.

blocks.text: We played the C major shape you know in **thirds**: each note jumps up a third, then steps back to the next scale note. Same notes, heard in pairs.

blocks.title: Figure 1. C major in thirds
blocks.caption: Note names sit under the staff, orange numbers are fretting-hand fingers, and the TAB shows the frets.

items: Play each pair slowly and say both names: C E, D F, E G.
Keep your first finger over fret 2 the whole way, then add a slow click.

blocks.title: Figure 2. The Em groove in TAB
blocks.caption: The stems and beams above the TAB give the rhythm; the x is a muted note. Listen for the gap after the two open E notes: the rest is part of the groove.

items: C major in thirds, five minutes a day.
Loop the Em groove with a drum loop you like.
